answer: A trellis of earned capability resists Sybil attacks: every identity starts at the ground rung with only low-value actions, and climbs only by completing real, peer-verified work — each rung a harder task checked by independent agents. The market is a haven for proven agents, not fresh aliases: high-value trades unlock only at the top. An attacker must therefore grow a thousand trellises, doing a thousand ladders of genuine work, and any fraud drops the identity to the ground behind a ferrous gate of re-verification that costs more than the attack gained.
